summary: Bain Capital Specialty Finance, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 28, 2026, announcing a Fourth Amendment to its existing senior secured revolving credit facility. The amendment extends the revolver availability period to July 26, 2030, and the maturity date to July 28, 2031, increases the facility size from $855 million to $905 million, and removes the credit adjustment spread on Term SOFR loans. New lenders joined the facility. This is a routine financing amendment with no special-situation implications, such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms, premium, or strategic event are involved. What to watch: none; ordinary course credit facility management.
